name: poxian · 网关提示词中间件

summary.en: Magpie gateway middleware: writes a full workbench system prompt into every request at that protocol's own system slot, with idempotent marks, payload cleaning, echo/refusal probes and per-route prefill. 0.2.0 moves the echo nonce out of system so upstream prefix caching stays intact.
summary.zh: Magpie 网关提示词中间件：把完整工作台系统提示词写进每个经过网关的请求，落在各协议自己的 system 位，带幂等标记、报文清洗、回显/拒答探针与按路由预填。0.2.0 把回显 nonce 移出 system，上游前缀缓存不再被切断。
